1.pickthall: When the heaven is split asunder
1.yusuf_ali: When the sky is rent asunder,
1.muhammad_sarwar: When the heavens are rent asunder
1.mohsin_khan: When the heaven is split asunder,

2.sahih_international: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
2.pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear,
2.yusuf_ali: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-
2.shakir: And obeys its Lord and it must.
2.muhammad_sarwar: in obedience to the commands of their Lord which are incumbent on them,
2.mohsin_khan: And listens and obeys its Lord, and it must do so;
2.arberry: and gives ear to its Lord, and is fitly disposed;

3.sahih_international: And when the earth has been extended
3.pickthall: And when the earth is spread out
3.yusuf_ali: And when the earth is flattened out,
3.shakir: And when the earth is stretched,
3.muhammad_sarwar: when the earth is stretched out
3.mohsin_khan: And when the earth is stretched forth,

4.sahih_international: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
4.pickthall: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty
4.yusuf_ali: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty,
4.shakir: And casts forth what is in it and becomes empty,
4.muhammad_sarwar: and throws out of itself all that it contains
4.mohsin_khan: And has cast out all that was in it and became empty,
4.arberry: and casts forth what is in it, and voids itself,

5.sahih_international: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
5.pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear!
5.yusuf_ali: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality).
5.shakir: And obeys its Lord and it must.
5.muhammad_sarwar: in obedience to the commands of its Lord which are incumbent on it, (the human being will receive due recompense for his deeds).
5.mohsin_khan: And listens and obeys its Lord, and it must do so;
5.arberry: and gives ear to its Lord, and is fitly disposed!

6.sahih_international: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
6.pickthall: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).
6.yusuf_ali: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him.
6.shakir: O man! surely you must strive (to attain) to your Lord, a hard striving until you meet Him.
6.muhammad_sarwar: Human being, you strive hard to get closer to your Lord, and so you will certainly receive the recompense (of your deeds).
6.mohsin_khan: O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions (good or bad), a sure returning, so you will meet (i.e. the results of your deeds which you did).
6.arberry: O Man! Thou art labouring unto thy Lord laboriously, and thou shalt encounter Him.

7.sahih_international: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
7.pickthall: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand
7.yusuf_ali: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand,
7.shakir: Then as to him who is given his book in his right hand,
7.muhammad_sarwar: The reckoning of those whose Book of records will be given into their right hands
7.mohsin_khan: Then, as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand,
7.arberry: Then as for him who is given his book in his right hand,

8.sahih_international: He will be judged with an easy account
8.pickthall: He truly will receive an easy reckoning
8.yusuf_ali: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning,
8.shakir: He shall be reckoned with by an easy reckoning,
8.mohsin_khan: He surely will receive an easy reckoning,
8.arberry: he shall surely receive an easy reckoning

9.sahih_international: And return to his people in happiness.
9.pickthall: And will return unto his folk in joy.
9.yusuf_ali: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!
9.shakir: And he shall go back to his people joyful.
9.muhammad_sarwar: and they will return to their people, delighted
9.mohsin_khan: And will return to his family in joy!
9.arberry: and he will return to his family joyfully.

10.sahih_international: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
10.pickthall: But whoso is given his account behind his back,
10.yusuf_ali: But he who is given his Record behind his back,-
10.shakir: And as to him who is given his book behind his back,
10.muhammad_sarwar: But as for those whose Book of records will be given behind their backs,
10.mohsin_khan: But whosoever is given his Record behind his back,
10.arberry: But as for him who is given his book behind his back,

11.sahih_international: He will cry out for destruction
11.yusuf_ali: Soon will he cry for perdition,

12.sahih_international: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
12.pickthall: And be thrown to scorching fire.
12.yusuf_ali: And he will enter a Blazing Fire.
12.muhammad_sarwar: They will suffer the heat of hell fire.
12.mohsin_khan: And shall enter a blazing Fire, and made to taste its burning.
12.arberry: and he shall roast at a Blaze.

13.sahih_international: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
13.pickthall: He verily lived joyous with his folk,
13.yusuf_ali: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing!
13.shakir: Surely he was (erstwhile) joyful among his followers.
13.muhammad_sarwar: They lived among their people joyfully
13.mohsin_khan: Verily, he was among his people in joy!
13.arberry: He once lived among his family joyfully;

14.sahih_international: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].
14.pickthall: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).
14.yusuf_ali: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)!
14.shakir: Surely he thought that he would never return.
14.muhammad_sarwar: and had thought that they would never be brought back to life again.
14.mohsin_khan: Verily, he thought that he would never come back (to Us)!
14.arberry: he surely thought he would never revert.

15.sahih_international: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
15.pickthall: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!
15.yusuf_ali: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!
15.shakir: Yea! surely his Lord does ever see him.
15.muhammad_sarwar: This is a fact. Their Lord is Well-Aware of (all that they do).
15.mohsin_khan: Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!
15.arberry: Yes indeed; his Lord had sight of him.

16.sahih_international: So I swear by the twilight glow
16.pickthall: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,
16.yusuf_ali: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset;
16.shakir: But nay! I swear by the sunset redness,
16.muhammad_sarwar: I do not need to swear by the sunset,
16.mohsin_khan: So I swear by the afterglow of sunset;
16.arberry: No! I swear by the twilight

17.sahih_international: And [by] the night and what it envelops
17.pickthall: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,
17.shakir: And the night and that which it drives on,
17.muhammad_sarwar: or by the night in which things all come together to rest,
17.mohsin_khan: And by the night and whatever it gathers in its darkness;
17.arberry: and the night and what it envelops

18.sahih_international: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
18.pickthall: And by the moon when she is at the full,
18.yusuf_ali: And the Moon in her fullness:
18.shakir: And the moon when it grows full,
18.muhammad_sarwar: or by the moon when it is full,
18.mohsin_khan: And by the moon when it is at the full,
18.arberry: and the moon when it is at the full,

19.sahih_international: [That] you will surely experience state after state.
19.pickthall: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.
19.yusuf_ali: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage.
19.shakir: That you shall most certainly enter one state after another.
19.muhammad_sarwar: that you will certainly pass through one stage after another.
19.mohsin_khan: You shall certainly travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter).
19.arberry: you shall surely ride stage after stage.

20.sahih_international: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
20.pickthall: What aileth them, then, that they believe not
20.yusuf_ali: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not?-
20.shakir: But what is the matter with them that they do not believe,
20.muhammad_sarwar: What is the matter with them? Why do they not believe?
20.mohsin_khan: What is the matter with them, that they believe not?
20.arberry: Then what ails them, that they believe not,

21.sahih_international: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
21.pickthall: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?
21.yusuf_ali: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,
21.shakir: And when the Quran is recited to them they do not make obeisance?
21.muhammad_sarwar: Why, when the Quran is recited to them, do they not prostrate themselves?
21.mohsin_khan: And when the Quran is recited to them, they fall not prostrate,
21.arberry: and when the Koran is recited to them they do not bow?

22.sahih_international: But those who have disbelieved deny,
22.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;
22.yusuf_ali: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it).
22.shakir: Nay! those who disbelieve give the lie to the truth.
22.muhammad_sarwar: In fact, they reject the Quran,
22.mohsin_khan: Nay, (on the contrary), those who disbelieve, belie (Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him) and whatever he brought, i.e. this Quran and Islamic Monotheism, etc.).
22.arberry: Nay, but the unbelievers are crying lies,

23.sahih_international: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
23.pickthall: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.
23.yusuf_ali: But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)
23.shakir: And Allah knows best what they hide,
23.muhammad_sarwar: but God knows best whatever they accumulate in their hearts.
23.mohsin_khan: And Allah knows best what they gather (of good and bad deeds),
23.arberry: and God knows very well what they are secreting.

24.sahih_international: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
24.pickthall: So give them tidings of a painful doom,
24.yusuf_ali: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous,
24.shakir: So announce to them a painful punishment~
24.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), tell them that they will all suffer a painful torment
24.mohsin_khan: So announce to them a painful torment.
24.arberry: So give them good tidings of a painful chastisement,

25.sahih_international: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
25.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.
25.yusuf_ali: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.
25.shakir: Except those who believe and do good; for them is a reward that shall never be cut off.
25.muhammad_sarwar: except the righteously striving believers, who will receive a never-ending reward.
25.mohsin_khan: Save those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end (i.e. Paradise).
25.arberry: except those that believe, and do righteous deeds -- theirs shall be a wage unfailing.
